summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Barão Distribuidora. Backend: 35/35 pytest cases pass (auth/JWT, categories, products, promotions, config, upload+file serve, authz 401s, validation, cascade delete, promo date-window filtering, bcrypt $2b$ hash check). Frontend: home loader→hero→4 category cards→category-filtered product grid→Promoção do Dia, cart add/inc/dec/total, checkout dialog → WhatsApp deep link with correct phone from config, floating WhatsApp, admin login (invalid=error toast, valid→/admin), all 5 tabs, product CRUD incl. real image upload to object storage, active toggle, category create, promotion create, config save + persistence after reload, protected route guard for missing/invalid token, mobile 390px layout (no horizontal overflow, mobile menu works). Found 1 functional cart pricing bug, 1 missing promo-price validation, 1 React setState-during-render warning, plus minor design items. All TEST_ data cleaned up and config restored to defaults.

minor.issue: No validation that promo_price is > 0 and < the linked product's price. Creating a promo of R$59.90 for an R$18.00 product is accepted and the storefront renders it as a discount (original price struck through). Also product_id is not validated to exist.
Returns 200 {ok:true} for non-existent ids (no 404). Deleting a category does not check/repoint products that reference its slug, leaving orphaned products invisible on the storefront.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout — 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 with no throttle (playbook item 4 not implemented).

Playbook items 2 and 3 not applicable/not implemented: token is returned in JSON body and stored in localStorage (no httpOnly cookie), and CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False. Matches the requested Bearer-token design, but localStorage tokens are XSS-exposed and origins are unrestricted.

starts_at/ends_at are compared as raw strings against an ISO 'now'. Works for UTC-normalized values, but the admin sends datetime-local values without timezone/seconds (e.g. '2026-07-01T10:00'), so the string comparison can misjudge windows for non-UTC input.

ui_bugs.issue: navigate() is called during render (`if (user) { nav('/admin'); return null; }`) causing the React console error 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component'. Use <Navigate to="/admin" replace /> instead.
Product/category/promotion delete uses native window.confirm() instead of the shadcn AlertDialog, breaking the premium dark/gold look and making delete non-testable/dismissable by browsers.

integration_issues.flow: Add to cart from Promoção do Dia when the same product is already in the cart
integration_issues.issue: CartContext.addItem only increments qty for an existing id and never merges the new price fields. Repro: add 'Whisky R$99' from the products grid, then click promo-add for the same product (promo R$79.90) → cart shows 2 × R$99.00 = R$198.00, promo price ignored. The inverse order keeps the promo price for regular adds (under-charging). Fix: merge price/promo_price on re-add.
Promo card shows product.price struck-through next to promo_price even when promo_price > price (see backend validation gap), presenting a price increase as an offer; no -% badge in that case.

issues: Stats row occupies only the top ~200px; the rest of the 1080px viewport is empty — consider recent products/promos summary
Header actions 'Ver site' / 'Sair' sit at the far right where the sonner toast (top-right) overlaps them for ~2s after every save
Panel background is partially transparent — page cards bleed through behind the nav links, slightly reducing legibility

action_items: Fix CartContext.addItem to merge updated price/promo_price when the product is already in the cart (promo price currently ignored / or incorrectly retained).
Validate promotion promo_price (>0 and < product price) and that product_id exists, in both POST/PUT /api/promotions and the admin promo form.
Replace the render-time navigate() in AdminLogin.jsx with <Navigate replace /> to clear the React setState-during-render error.
Return 404 on DELETE of non-existent product/category ids; handle products orphaned by category deletion.
Optional hardening: login rate limiting and restricting CORS allow_origins to the app origin.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext.addItem: `if (found) return prev.map(i => i.id===id ? {...i, qty:i.qty+1} : i)` discards the incoming product payload — root cause of the promo pricing bug.
AdminLogin.jsx:17 performs navigation as a side effect inside the render body.
server.py list_promotions performs an N+1 product lookup per promotion; fine at current scale but should use $in/aggregate if catalogs grow.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.
Storage helpers (init_storage/put_object/get_object) use blocking `requests` inside async endpoints, blocking the event loop on upload/download — wrap in run_in_threadpool or use httpx.AsyncClient.
DELETE endpoints ignore delete_count, so callers cannot distinguish success from a missing resource.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all flows pass except cart promo re-pricing)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives in /app/backend/tests (pytest.ini fixed at -n 2 --dist loadscope; run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`) and was 35/35 green. Storefront starts with an empty catalog; use tests/seed_frontend_data.py to seed, and delete TEST_ items + reset config afterwards. Correct admin upload file input testid is `prod-img-file` / `cat-img-file` / `promo-img-file` (not prod-image-file). Loader delays home render by ~1.9s, so wait ~3.5s after navigation. Unsplash images on the homepage report naturalWidth=0 only because they are below the fold (verified HTTP 200) — not a bug.
rca_of_the_issue: Cart promo bug: CartContext.addItem matches by product id and, when found, returns {...existingItem, qty+1}, dropping the freshly passed promo_price/price. PromoDoDia passes {...product, promo_price: promo.promo_price}, so its price never reaches an item already added from the products grid (charges full price), and conversely a promo-added item keeps the promo price for later regular adds (undercharges). Fix: `{...i, ...product, qty: i.qty + 1}` or explicitly refresh price/promo_price. React warning RCA: AdminLogin calls useNavigate()'s nav() synchronously in the component body during render.
